app_tagline: Restore missing information in your Immich library
auth_intro: Sign in with your Immich account. You will see and change only your own library.
auth_help_steps: In Immich, open Account Settings → API Keys → New API Key.
auth_help_storage: The key is stored encrypted on the server of this app and is never sent back to the browser.
error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_core_unreachable: The app server does not respond.
error_server_not_configured: The app is not configured yet: set the Immich address and the secret key on the server.
error_immich_unreachable: The Immich server does not respond.
error_immich_missing_permissions: The API key lacks permissions: {permissions}. Edit the key in Immich and try again.
error_immich_permission_denied: Immich refused the request: the API key lacks a permission.
library_similar_hints_hint: The badge and the filter "similar photo with a location" are counted once a day and for new photos; count them for all photos now, e.g. after setting many locations
suggestions_reveal_title: Show here; which modules the card shows is set on the Settings page
display_hint: Order of the modules in the card and on the map, and which of them are shown. Hidden modules keep running.
gallery_all_done_text: New photos without a location appear here after the next sync.
gallery_empty_text: Change or reset the filter to see more photos.
photo_coordinates_invalid: Could not read the coordinates. Examples: 42.4249, 18.7713 or 42°25'30"N 18°46'17"E
error_immich_error: Immich returned an error. Please try again.
error_location_changed_in_immich: The location was changed in Immich after this app wrote it. Undo was cancelled so as not to overwrite it.
photo_save_note: The location is written to Immich a few seconds after saving; until then it can be cancelled.
photo_pending: The location of this photo will be saved in a few seconds.
error_location_null_island: Exactly 0, 0 cannot be saved: Immich treats it as "no location".
error_location_clear_failed: Immich did not remove the coordinates, so the saved point was kept.
photo_turned_note: Rotated here only, Immich is not changed. Modules started now get the photo rotated.
photo_rotation_saved: Rotation saved in Immich. The modules will look at the photo again.
photo_rotation_saved_later: Rotation saved in Immich; it is still making the new previews. The modules will look at the photo again after the next sync.
error_rotate_not_supported: Immich can rotate only photos, not videos.
auth_password_note: The password is checked by Immich and is not stored. On the first sign-in the app creates its own API key in your Immich account (named “immich-steward …”) and keeps it encrypted on its server.
auth_key_summary: Sign in with an API key instead
auth_key_intro: For example, if you sign in to Immich through OAuth and have no password.
auth_help_optional_edit: optional: saves a photo rotated in the app to Immich
auth_help_optional_download: optional: shows originals in full size
error_immich_invalid_credentials: Immich did not accept this email and password.
error_immich_password_login_failed: Immich refused password sign-in (it may be turned off on the server). Sign in with an API key instead.
module_note_no_neighbors: No photos with a location close in time.
module_note_scanner: Looks like a scan: its date is the scan date, so time neighbors are not suggested.
candidate_estimated: neighbor's location was set by hand
module_similar_none: No photos of the same place with a location in your library yet.
candidate_similar_details: Where the most similar photo of your library was taken. Similar photos of this place: {count}. Confidence is how often such a match turns out right within 1 km.
module_status_not_run: Not run on this photo yet.
module_no_candidates: No confident areas: the photo gives too little to go on.
module_no_worker: No worker running this module is connected now, so the run waits until one starts (see the Processing page).
candidate_area: Area that looks like the photo
workers_intro: Workers run the heavy location modules (GeoCLIP, similar photos) on the server or on another computer.
workers_none: No worker has connected yet. See “Worker” in the installation guide.
workers_forget_hint: Remove from the list; if it connects again, it shows up again. Workers not seen for 30 days are removed by themselves.
add_device_intro: Another computer of your home network can run a worker too: a desktop, a laptop with a graphics card. Pick how and copy the commands; the address, the name and the token are filled in.
add_device_no_token: The server has no worker token: workers are refused. Set STEWARD_WORKER_TOKEN in the server's .env (see the documentation) and restart the app.
add_device_token_hidden: The worker token is shown to administrators of Immich only. Ask yours, or take STEWARD_WORKER_TOKEN from the server's .env, and put it in place of your-token.
add_device_address_hint: The address must be reachable from that computer (port 8780 by default, not Immich's 2283). Give every worker a name of its own.
add_device_gpu_note: Several times faster than Docker; needs an NVIDIA card with 4 GB of memory and a driver 580 or newer.
add_device_step_run: Run in a terminal (PowerShell on Windows)
add_device_step_tools: Once: install Git and uv, then open a new PowerShell window
add_device_step_install: Once: download the worker of this version
add_device_step_file_windows: Save as D:\steward-worker\start-worker.cmd and start it with a double-click
add_device_step_start_linux: Make it executable and start it
add_device_docs: More in the documentation: checking, stopping, updating
workers_module_on_hint: On: this worker takes jobs of the module. Click to turn it off: the jobs wait for another worker.
workers_module_off_hint: Off: this worker takes no jobs of the module. Click to turn it on; it takes effect with its next job, no restart.
workers_refused_worker_too_old: This worker is too old for the app ({core}): update the worker.
workers_refused_core_too_old: This worker needs a newer app: update the app on the server.
workers_update_hint: The app on the server is newer than this worker. It keeps working, but an update brings the fixes of the new version.
worker_state_downloading: downloading the model of {module} (only the first time; it can take several minutes) · {time}
worker_state_loading: loading the model of {module} into memory · {time}
module_worker_loading: The worker is loading the model of this module; the first photo takes longer, sometimes a few minutes.
workers_index: Search index of similar photos: {indexed} of {located} photos with a location.
candidate_area_details: GeoCLIP compares the photo with 100 000 reference points around the world; {points} of the 200 most likely ones fall into this area. Confidence is their total probability.
suggestions_weak_more: {count} more weak suggestions (probably only the region is right)
filter_geoclip_confident_hint: Photos without a location that GeoCLIP marks as confident (75 % and above by default)
filter_similar_confident_hint: Photos without a location that look confidently like a photo with one (80 % and above by default); counted in the background, once a day and for new photos
asset_similar_confident: A similar photo has a location
filter_nearby_hint: Photos without a location taken within {minutes} min of a photo with one: the place is almost surely known
asset_nearby_same: A photo with a location was taken within {minutes} min by the same camera
asset_nearby_other: A photo with a location was taken within {minutes} min by another camera
keys_locate: Show a suggestion on the map
keys_part: Recognize a part of the photo
keys_map: Click the map to pick a point; a click near the dashed line between the neighbors lands on it.
failure_image_unavailable: Immich could not give the photo (deleted, or Immich cannot make its preview)
failure_immich_auth: Immich refused the API key of the account
failure_image_invalid: The worker cannot read the photo
failure_module_error: The module failed on the photo
failure_worker_error: The worker could not report the result
failure_lease_expired_hint: Earlier versions of the app did not keep the real reason. Run it again to see it.
pause_bar_all: Background runs of all modules are paused.
pause_bar_all_until: Background runs of all modules are paused until {time}.
module_paused: Background runs of this module are paused; you can still run it from here.
workers_pause_hint: A pause holds the background runs, for every user of this installation. Runs started from a photo still go, and runs in progress are finished.
module_card_manual: only when started from a photo
module_card_no_worker: No connected worker runs this module.
module_part_run: Recognize a part of the photo
module_part_hint: Select a part of the photo, e.g. a building behind people, and run the module on it only
region_title: Select a part of the photo
region_hint: Drag to draw a frame; drag its corners, sides or inside to adjust it. Wheel: zoom. Right or middle button, or Space + drag: move the photo. Esc: close.
region_too_small: Part: {w} × {h} px — very small, the module will hardly recognize anything in it.
device_same_only_hint: Count only photos of the same camera as this one; holds for the next photos too
mapsrc_auto_unset: Choose the far and near sources in Settings.
mapsrc_hint: Satellite imagery under the map labels. Everything is off until you switch a source on, which means you accept its terms. The browser loads the tiles straight from the provider: it sees your address and the area you look at. Each account has its own keys.
mapsrc_quality_eox: 10 m per pixel: coast, fields, mountains, towns as patches; no buildings. A layer per year, 2016–2025.
mapsrc_quality_esri: 1 m or better in many places, often much better in towns.
mapsrc_quality_maptiler: 0.5–2 m: best in Western Europe and the USA, 2 m elsewhere.
mapsrc_terms_eox: No key. Free for non-commercial use (2016: CC BY 4.0, later years: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
mapsrc_terms_esri: Key of an ArcGIS Location Platform account. 2 million tiles a month free; without pay-as-you-go the access just closes until the next month. Do not share the key.
mapsrc_terms_maptiler: Key of a MapTiler Cloud account. The free plan is for non-commercial use only: 100,000 requests a month, then the service pauses until the next month. The MapTiler logo is shown on the map.
mapsrc_key_restrict: the key is seen by the browser, so restrict it to the address of this app in the provider's settings.
mapsrc_check_unreachable: Could not reach the provider to check the key; it is saved anyway.
mapsrc_own_count_hint: Only the tiles of this account in this app: the same key may be used elsewhere, and tiles from the browser cache are counted too.
mapsrc_own_count_estimate: A rough estimate: the provider counts in its own way, and its numbers may differ.
map_areas_hint: How the likely areas of the suggestions are drawn
map_two_fingers: Use two fingers to move the map
map_heatmap_hint: Where your photos with a location are: a hint to find the place on the map
mapsrc_period_esri: Esri counts its month from the day your account's billing started (Location Platform → Usage).
mapsrc_period_maptiler: MapTiler counts by the billing period of your plan (Cloud → Analytics).
mapsrc_usage_hint: A service token (MapTiler Cloud → Account → Credentials) lets this server ask MapTiler how much the account used. The token gives full access to your MapTiler account: it stays on this server, is never sent to the browser and is used only to read the usage.
mapsrc_usage_token_invalid: MapTiler did not accept the service token.
mapsrc_usage_unreachable: MapTiler did not answer; the numbers are from the last answer.
mapsrc_usage_estimate: MapTiler expects {n} by the end of the period.
mapsrc_usage_delay: MapTiler reports whole days: today is not counted yet.
mapsrc_auto_settings_hint: With “Auto” over the map, it shows the far source out to the zoom below and the near one from it. A source that does not work is skipped for the next one; at the end the plain map.
mapsrc_zoom_scale: Zoom: 10 — a whole city, 12 — districts, 14 — streets are seen, 16 — single houses stand apart, 18 — yards, cars and trees.
mapsrc_auto_settings_link: Settings of the switching by zoom
mapsrc_auto_none: Switch a source on above to choose it here.
error_map_source_needs_key: Enter the key of this source first.
error_map_source_not_enabled: Only a source that is on can be chosen.
select_photo_hint: Choose (with Shift: everything from the photo chosen before)
peek_sound_off_browser: The browser did not let the sound play
select_day_hint: Choose all the photos of the day, or unchoose them
selection_rotate_videos_only: Only videos are chosen: they are not turned.
selection_overwrite: Overwrite it also on the {count} of {total} chosen photos that already have a location
selection_suggestions_note: Only what is already known: places of the chosen photos, the photos just before and after them in time, and confident results of the modules. Nothing is run.
module_note_none_located: None of the chosen photos has a location.
candidate_selected: {count} of the chosen photos are here
save_skipped_located: {count} with a location were left as they were.
save_kept: {count} changed since were left as they are.
photo_work_waiting: The location will be saved in a few seconds
photo_work_working: Being saved or turned in Immich…
rotate_running: Turning the photos in Immich: {done} of {total}
rotate_videos: Videos among the chosen ({count}) are not turned.
update_badge_hint: What is new in it, and how to update
updates_hint: For all users of this installation.
updates_privacy: Twice a day the server asks GitHub for the number of the latest version. GitHub sees the IP address of the server; no photos or data are sent.
updates_none_yet: No release to compare with yet.
copy_failed: The browser did not allow copying: press Ctrl+C
gallery_settings_tooltip_hint: Resting the mouse on a photo shows its file name, when it was taken, the camera and the size. Off: the file name only.
gallery_settings_video_sound: Sound of videos in the large preview
gallery_settings_video_sound_hint: A video shown large on a long press plays at once; with this on, with its sound. The browser may still start it muted.
groups_spread_hint: The photos with a location lie more than 1 km apart.
groups_empty_text: Groups appear once the photos with a vector have been compared with each other.
groups_failed: The last pass failed; it will be tried again.
groups_no_photos: No photos are left in this group.
groups_settings_similarity_hint: From 0.10 to 0.95. Higher: smaller, more exact groups. Lower: larger groups that may mix different places.
groups_settings_core: Close photos needed to hold a group together
groups_settings_core_hint: From 1 to 30. A photo with fewer close photos can join a group but does not link groups.
groups_settings_mutual_hint: Two photos are close only when each is among the most similar of the other. Off: groups can chain into thousands of photos from different places.
groups_settings_rebuild_hint: A change rebuilds the groups in the background. Names and your changes to groups stay.
groups_settings_search_again_hint: New photos are compared on their own. This is rarely needed and can take about an hour on a large library.
groups_trash_hint: These photos show nothing of the place (a pet, a document): they are never used to suggest a place. Their locations in Immich stay as they are.
groups_map_hint: A click on a point or a number chooses its photos; another click takes them off the choice.
groups_near_hint: Similar photos that are in no group. Add those that belong here.
candidate_group: {count} photos of this group are here
groups_settings_split_hint: Large groups whose photos lie in different places (beaches, say) are split with a stricter similarity; photos that fit nowhere then leave the groups.
groups_similarity_hint: How close photos are to the others of the group, from 0 to 1. A photo much lower than the rest may not belong here.
groups_recount_hint: The groups are being built again without these photos; it takes about a minute. Reload the page to see the result.
groups_trashed_hint: These photos are not used to suggest a place and link no groups. Their locations in Immich stay as they are.
error_groups_busy: The groups are being worked on. Try again when it is over.
groups_settings_reset_hint: Takes about a minute. Group names and your changes to groups are removed.
groups_reset_warning: All groups are built anew. Their names, the photos you added or took out and the trash marks of groups are removed and cannot be brought back. Single photos in the trash stay there.
